li.label: sent a letter home
li.description: A scribe wrote down what I wanted to say, and it's on its way to someone who'll be glad to read it.

li.label: our story written down
li.description: The colony's story is written out fair and bound in leather. Someone will read it long after we're gone.

li.label: our picture on the wall
li.description: There's a picture of all of us on the wall now. I look at it every time I walk past.

li.label: a glitterworlder's questions
li.description: A tourist from a glitterworld stayed with us and asked about everything. Where the water comes from. Why the beds are so hard. It was funny, mostly.

li.label: a glitterworlder in the barn
li.description: I watched a rich tourist from a glitterworld muck out the barn. I'll remember that for a long time.

li.label: the spirit-singer's song
li.description: A spirit-singer sang to the land all night by our fire. The drum is still going in my head.

li.label: our dead were sung to
li.description: A singer went from grave to grave and sang to each of our dead. It felt like they were finally put to rest.

li.label: a traveling cook's feast
li.description: A traveling cook took over our kitchen for a day and made the best meal I've had in years, out of our own stores.

li.label: learned from a real cook
li.description: A traveling cook spent a whole day teaching me. I hold a knife differently now.

li.label: a healer saw to me
li.description: A traveling healer saw what was wrong and saw to it, and the council paid. I feel better already.

li.label: someone played just for me
li.description: A musician sat with me last night and played until I fell asleep. I didn't know how tired I was until then.

li.label: they came to see how we decide
li.description: Envoys came all the way from a neighbor's town to watch how our council works. We must be doing something right.

li.label: a taste of home
li.description: A peddler had food from where I grew up, and the council bought it for me. One bite and I was a child again.

li.label: a supper from someone's home
li.description: We ate a supper from someone else's homeland tonight, with the stories that go with it. Strange food, good evening.

li.label: made peace with an old enemy
li.description: Someone who wronged me before I came here came all this way to say sorry. I didn't know how much I'd been carrying.

li.label: an old wound reopened
li.description: Someone from my old life came to apologize, and it only brought it all back. I shouldn't have let them in.

li.label: our dead have proper markers
li.description: Every grave has a proper marker now, with the name cut in stone. It feels like the colony is keeping its promises.

li.label: a feast at the camp
li.description: We were guests at the camp's fire last night. Good food, new faces, songs I'd never heard.

li.label: the council backed me
li.description: I had a quarrel with someone from the camp, and the council took my side.

li.label: the council gave it away
li.description: I had the better claim, and the council let the camp have it anyway, to keep the peace.
